profile.headline: Senior Systems Integration Engineer at Cisco
profile.summary:
I am a DevOps engineer with considerable expertise in continuous integration continuous deployment. I strive to architect, build, enable, drive, and enhance the deployment of enterprise tools and platforms while influencing a diverse culture working towards an automated and immutable infrastructure, everything as code.  I am always willing to take up challenging assignments and willing to learn new technologies.

Core Competencies Include the Following:
► DevOps Enablement development and coaching
► Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment
► Amazon Web Services architecture and solutions
► Expert in Atlassian JIRA and Confluence architecture, deployment, configuration, administration, optimal usage, performance, and OAuth for REST APIs.

Key Technologies:
► Operating Systems: Linux, Windows, scripting languages (Bash, Python, Perl)
► Cloud Infrastructure and Virtualization: Amazon Web Services (VPC, ELB, EFS, EBS, RDS, S3, Security Groups, CloudFormation, Step Functions, CLIs, Lambda, Backup and Restore), Kubernetes, OracleBox.
► Software Development Systems: GitHub, Jenkins, Docker, Jira, Confluence
► Software Development Tools: Ansible, Visual Studio Code, GitHub Desktop, Eclipse
► Software Development Language: Java, Ansible, Phython, VB.NET, ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript
► Databases: MySQL, Microsoft SQL, Oracle, Postgres
► Application Framework: Spring Framework, ASP.NET

positions.title: DevOps Enablement Engineer
positions.description:
Serve as a member of a high-performance DevOps Enablement team responsible for the software engineering tools and platforms for the company and its clients.

► Demonstrated solid performance, key contributors have been the Confluence and JIRA manageability. Critical advancements have been the Confluence re-platforming and security remediation. Being a key driver in the JIRA upgrade, re-platforming, and user automation strategy. This work is critical to enable the DXC agile transformation.

► Being a key driver in Confluence upgrade by developing and deploying Confluence Data Center on the AWS Cloud infrastructure with various AWS components, Jenkins, GitHub, Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, etc. to automate software deployment and upgrade process that can be executed on our continuous delivery pipeline based on pull requests.

► More recently I also actively contributed to the migration of Platform DXC Release Pipeline applications from the AWS Sandbox account to remediate security concerns with that account. In that role I became familiar with many new technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Apps, Grafana, etc...) that I then successfully used to help the overall team effort. I had continued to expand my knowledge and is now helping with other Platform DXC topics such as automating change management processes or improving Infra-Core component.

► Played a technical oversight of JIRA and Confluence applications. In that role, the most important accomplishment had been the migration of major JIRA and Confluence sites into company-wide Atlassian JIRA and Confluence.  During the migration I was responsible for automating various stages of the process, including user migration, projects, plugins' content, and finally data validation. All these efforts led to minimizing manual work and therefore speeding up the entire process, which turned out to be much more complex than initially estimated.

positions.title: DevOps Enablement Engineer
positions.description:
► Wrote a JIRA plugin to deactivate inactive JIRA users using Java and installed in the company-wide Atlassian JIRA plugin application.  

► Wrote a Java client scheduled by Cron job to automatically disable the JIRA and Confluence inactive users.  This process saves the company cost to maintain the unforeseen increasing number of JIRA and Confluence license costs.

positions.title: Information Systems Architect
positions.description:
► Worked as a technical lead for Option Tree Tool project activities that include but are not limited to meeting all agreed-upon deliverables, timely communication with stakeholders including IT and business management. Also, I participated in developing and implementing OTT enhancement project using DevOps methodology and other activities.

► Worked as a technical lead for RnD Wiki project activities that include but are not limited to meeting all agreed-upon deliverables, timely communication with stakeholders including IT and business management. Worked with management, PM, and other technical leads to define the next functional upgrade to the latest Confluence version and save Confluence License cost.

► Played a critical deep level support role for a series of engineering knowledge applications Copernicus, EG KM Server XML Transform, ISS Traq, Arbortext.

► Worked with management PM to assist migrating DXC R&D Wiki to DevCloud Wiki and archived unused wiki spaces to SharePoint.

► Spitted and migrated data from HPE R&D Wiki (Confluence) into DXC R&D Wiki and Seattle R&D Wiki new environment.

► Completed all other RE-IP’s and implemented OneHp Unified ID for applications EG KM Server XML Transform, ISSTraq, Copernicus, Arbortext, and Option Tree Tool.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
► Upgraded Confluence from 5.0.3 to 5.4.4 and did R&D Wiki Atlanta Data Center Exit. This was one of the first upgrade effort led by Tien alone after the previous technical lead had left the team. Tien completed the upgrade effort and introduce the new capability in username change. Even though there were initial challenges, Tien single-handedly complete the migration and responded to numerous inquiries from users, including those who just do not follow instructions. Tien’s patience and professionalism were critical in managing a solution with such broad user-based. As part of the split effort, Tien also worked closely with Rosey Loaisiga as project manager to complete the clone, cleanse, and go effort. This requires in-depth knowledge of Confluence’ inner logics, which is beyond Tien’s usual system administration expertise.

► Acted as the scrum master for the ongoing Option Tree Tool (OTT) project which is critical for the EG business.

► Played a critical deep level support role for a series of engineering knowledge applications Copernicus, EG KM Server XML Transform, ISS Traq, Arbortext, HPBrain. My responsibility including not just daily operation but being available in any hours if system availability is threatened, users and any fire drills related to separation, velocity, etc. My role in deep-level support highlighted a sound approach in risk-taking, as it should only be in the best interests of the organization engineering community.

► As far as application modernization, I migrated every one of these applications. For ISS Traq for example, even though initially I did reply on customer’s engagement on technical knowledge, I soon assumed the role truly as a Project Manager, and assign tasks to customers, GDBA team, Accenture team, IT Hosting team and managed the overall effort. I managed to synchronize everyone work so it will go on the same path as the project agenda.

positions.title: IT Developer/Engineer
positions.description:
► Continued to play a critical deep level support role for a series of engineering knowledge applications R&D Wiki (Confluence), Copernicus, EG KM Server XML Transform, ISS Traq, Arbortext, Option Tree Tool, and HPBrain.

► Participated in developing and implementing the Options Tree Tool enhancement project and other activities.

► Worked with Project Manager and Technical Manager to accurately estimate proposed solutions.

► Analyzed and recommended re-engineered cost-effective solutions.

► Maintained schedules, managed budget, and completed tasks within deadlines.

► Prepared progress reports identified issues ahead of time and provided solutions.

► Created reusable code repository.

► Developed, customized, maintained, and upgraded software for new releases.

► Evaluated requirements for the integration process. Converted functional requirements into technical requirements.

► Followed complete software development life cycle: requirements, design, build, test and deployment.

► Developed application using Java, Hibernate, Spring Strut, Spring MVC, Tomcat, Weblogic, Jboss, SQL Server, ASP.NET, VB.NET, C#, SQL Server, VB, SAP (ABAP).
